title: The Rains — EN/SN/ES (Mbira Folk)
style: Zimbabwean mbira folk urban grooves acoustic guitar hosho shakers ngoma drums warm baritone 82bpm analog tape warm storytelling Shona Spanish heritage rain seasons Zimbabwe
lyrics:
[Verse 1 — English]
When the rains come to Zimbabwe the whole country breathes again
The dust that was the road becomes the river in the rain
The cattle lift their heads and the children go outside
The rains are the signal that the whole dry season tried to hide

[Verse 2 — Shona, with English translation]
Mvura painouya kuZimbabwe nyika yose inofema patsva
[When the rain comes to Zimbabwe the whole country breathes again]
Guruva raiva mugwagwa rinotendera zvino kuva rwizi
[The dust that was the road now flows as a river]
Zvipfuyo zvinosimudzira musoro uye vana vanobuda panze
[The cattle lift their heads and the children go outside]
Mvura ndiyo chiratidzo — nguva yekuoma yaipeda
[The rain is the signal — the dry season is ending]

[Chorus — English]
The rains, the rains
Coming down on the kopjes and the msasa red remains
The rains know what the farm was waiting for before we knew
The rains come down in Zimbabwe and the whole world starts new

[Bridge — Spanish, with English translation]
Cuando las lluvias llegan a Zimbabwe el país entero respira
[When the rains come to Zimbabwe the whole country breathes]
El polvo que era el camino se convierte en río que prospira
[The dust that was the road becomes a flowing river]
Las vacas levantan la cabeza y los niños salen afuera
[The cattle lift their heads and the children go outside]
Las lluvias son la señal de que la estación seca ya no impera
[The rains are the signal that the dry season no longer rules]

[Outro — All three languages]
The rains know the farm… Mvura inoziva munda… Las lluvias conocen la granja
First rain breaks everything open — Mvura yekutanga inovhura zvose — La primera lluvia abre todo
The gardens still growing
